notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.1.5 - Poll and Script: an exception reply (01, 02, 03 ...) is the slave's answer and is no longer retried, so a write is never sent twice; only no response, busy (06) and gateway (0A/0B) are retried. Script: a step that gets an exception now FAILs with the exception code instead of counting as DISCONNECT, and no longer skips the rest of the case. Slave: an RTU broadcast write reaches every Slave ID of the device; Slave IDs are limited to 1-247; the device list and tab counts update right away. Poll: New / Open Project starts with empty counters and log. Command line: each error is printed once, with no Qt warning.
